included.note: Reaches the published source of a record the export summarises. It names no type, so it supports the lookup skills and travels only where at least one of them did.
Reads a term from corpus/glossary/terms.jsonl and the owning glossary record beside it.
Reads a clause from corpus/policies/clauses.jsonl and the owning policy beside it.
Reads a process from corpus/processes/ and hands the steps to corpus-retrieval, because a process export carries the trigger and not the order.
Reads a rule from corpus/standards/rules.jsonl and the owning standard beside it.
A SessionStart hook printing the breadcrumb rendered beside it, so a session learns the glossary is here before it has a term to look up.
